name: gold_standard_gbfs_france
description: An audited, certified national reference dataset of 46,307 bike-sharing stations covering 57 French urban areas. Built from the systematic audit of the 122 French GBFS systems published on transport.data.gouv.fr and MobilityData, classified by a taxonomy of five anomaly classes (A1-A5) and enriched by spatial joining with INSEE Filosofi, BAAC (Cerema), BD TOPO, OpenStreetMap and the FUB Cycling Barometer. Released as a versioned Parquet file with an audit report and a JSON Schema.

affiliation.name: CESI, CESI Engineering School, Montpellier, France

citeAs: Fossé R., Pallares G. (2026). Gold Standard GBFS France v1.0.0 [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.XXXXXXX

distribution.name: stations_gold_standard_final.parquet
distribution.description: Main certified station-level table. One row per certified station, 30 columns covering identity, geolocation, capacity, audit verdict and contextual enrichment.

distribution.name: systems_catalog.csv
distribution.description: Catalogue of the 122 audited GBFS systems with their audit verdict (ok / too_small / no_si_url / fetch_error / autopartage / dom_tom / excluded).

distribution.name: audit_report.pdf
distribution.description: Per-system audit report, including the verdict, the rule that triggered it and the raw GBFS payload extract.

recordSet.name: stations
recordSet.description: One row per certified bike-sharing station in the Gold Standard.

field.name: uid
field.description: Globally unique station identifier (concatenation of system_id and station_id).

field.name: system_id
field.description: Identifier of the GBFS system (operator + city), as advertised on transport.data.gouv.fr.

field.name: system_name
field.description: Human-readable name of the GBFS system.

field.name: source
field.description: Provenance of the entry: 'gbfs' (ingested from a GBFS feed) or 'osm_backfill' (resolved against OSM when a GBFS payload was incomplete).

field.name: station_id
field.description: Native station identifier as published by the operator.

field.name: station_name
field.description: Human-readable station name.

field.name: city
field.description: Urban area in which the station is located (after disambiguation against INSEE COG).

field.name: lat
field.description: Station latitude, WGS84.

field.name: lon
field.description: Station longitude, WGS84.

field.name: capacity
field.description: Declared station capacity (number of docks). For free-floating stations, this is the post-A3 corrected value (see capacity_corrected).

field.name: station_type
field.description: Audit verdict on the topology of the station: 'docked_bike' (physical dock), 'free_floating' (virtual anchor), 'carsharing' (A1, excluded from BSS analyses).

field.name: address
field.description: Free-form street address as advertised by the operator (may be empty).

field.name: region_id
field.description: INSEE region code of the urban area.

field.name: n_stations_system
field.description: Total number of certified stations in the system the station belongs to.

field.name: fetched_at
field.description: UTC timestamp at which the raw GBFS payload was fetched (ISO-8601).

field.name: elevation_m
field.description: Station elevation above sea level, in metres (SRTM 30 m, BD ALTI fallback).

field.name: topography_roughness_index
field.description: Topographic Roughness Index in a 500 m neighbourhood. Higher = hillier terrain.

field.name: infra_cyclable_km
field.description: Cumulated cycling-infrastructure linear (km) within a 300 m buffer (BD TOPO + OSM).

field.name: infra_cyclable_pct
field.description: Share of the 300 m buffer's street network that is cyclable (BD TOPO + OSM).

field.name: baac_accidents_cyclistes
field.description: Count of cyclist-related accidents in a 500 m buffer over five years (BAAC, Cerema).

field.name: gtfs_heavy_stops_300m
field.description: Number of heavy-transit stops (tramway, metro, RER, train) within a 300 m buffer.

field.name: gtfs_stops_within_300m_pct
field.description: Share of the system's stations covered by at least one heavy-transit stop within 300 m.

field.name: code_commune
field.description: INSEE commune code (5-digit) of the station.

field.name: commune_name
field.description: INSEE commune name (official).

field.name: revenu_median_uc
field.description: Median income per consumption unit (INSEE Filosofi), at the IRIS or commune level.

field.name: gini_revenu
field.description: Local Gini index of income (INSEE Filosofi).

field.name: revenu_d1
field.description: First income decile (INSEE Filosofi).

field.name: ecart_interquar
field.description: Interquartile range of income (INSEE Filosofi).

field.name: part_menages_voit0
field.description: Share of households with no car (INSEE census).

field.name: part_velo_travail
field.description: Share of cycling commuting (INSEE Mobilités professionnelles), commune-level.
